B: Hiii! Oh my god, hi. I'm Holly. Can you hear me?
A: Hi, yeah, I can hear you. I'm Kerry.
B: Kerry, hi! Okay, I've got to say it, I saw your photo and I was like, that's literally my kitchen goals. The tap, the pampas grass. Love it.
A: Oh, thank you. We did the kitchen-diner last year, sort of grey and gold. It took forever, but yeah, I'm really pleased with it.
B: And is that a cockapoo in the corner?
A: Yeah, that's Biscuit.
B: Shut up. Ours is called Biscuit!
A: No way. [laughs] Is yours a chewer?
B: She eats my trainers. Like, the nice ones, never the old ones. Do you know what I mean?
A: Ours does the skirting boards. Mark's just given up repainting them, honestly.
B: Mark's your husband? What does he do?
A: He's a quantity surveyor, commercial, for a construction firm.
B: Stop it. Ryan's a quantity surveyor. This is actually weird now. [laughs] Are we the same person?
A: [laughs] Maybe. Where are you based?
B: Chelmsford. So Essex. You?
A: Bishop's Cleeve, just outside Cheltenham.
B: Oh, Cheltenham, the races! Do you go?
A: The Gold Cup, yeah, most years. Work sometimes gets hospitality tickets. It's more the day out really, the outfit and that.
B: Oh that's so fun. What do you do?
A: I'm a senior service advisor at a car dealership. Premium brand. So booking cars in, explaining the work to customers, service plans, warranties, that sort of thing.
B: Oh, so you get the angry ones.
A: All day. Someone kicked off this morning because their car wasn't ready, and it was because they'd brought it in two hours late. But yeah, you just stay calm, you know. They usually end up taking a service plan. [laughs]
B: Honestly, that's the skill, isn't it? I'm GM of a cocktail bar and restaurant in Chelmsford, so it's literally the same. Someone's screaming about their table and you're like, I'm so sorry, let me get you a drink on the house, and then they book a private hire. Turn it round.
A: Yeah, exactly that. Turn it round.
B: But I'm knackered. I did a double on Saturday and I think I'm still recovering. Like, I came home and fell asleep on the sofa in my coat.
A: Oh, I'm shattered most days. It's the school run with after-school clubs and my shifts, they never line up.
B: How old are yours?
A: Isla's eleven and Jacob's eight.
B: Aw. We haven't got any yet. Everyone keeps asking, my mum, Ryan's mum. I'm like, can I just get through Christmas first? [laughs]
A: Mother-in-laws, yeah. I won't say any more. [laughs]
B: [laughs] Say no more. Are you going away anywhere next year?
A: I'm trying to book early to get the deal. Probably Lanzarote, all-inclusive, with a kids' club. We did Orlando in 2022 and that sort of wiped us out.
B: Oh, Orlando! I'd love that. We did Bali for our honeymoon, I still talk about it constantly, Ryan's sick of me. I want Japan next, or Mexico.
A: Japan's a bit far for me, I think. I just want a nice pool, honestly.
B: No, a nice pool is valid. A nice pool and a cocktail that's actually made properly, not that pre-mix rubbish, that's all I ask.
A: Pink gin for me.
